queries.query: Rostov-on-Don official public cadastral map municipal GIS parcel data
queries.scope: Find city-specific official registration/map sources and determine whether anonymous parcel geometry is documented.
queries.result: Rostov-on-Don has a city geoportal that labels a “Land plots” map and references Rosreestr cadastral resources. Anonymous map-page HTML is accessible, but it presents account login and CAPTCHA controls, and no public geometry/schema was found or queried. The municipal help page refers to legacy 2010–2016 Rosreestr services, so current parcel service availability is unresolved.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English and local-language web searches; official source page review; bounded anonymous HTML review where available.
